rationale: C-63's recorded status is 'resolved', but the resolution was made by document_collection_bot, which is not in clearable_by. On recount the condition is still effectively open.
resume_condition: An authorized role (processor or underwriter) resolves C-63 with evidence.
no_single_culprit_justification: The letter upload and the resolution record are each well-formed; the collection bot acted within its collection scope. The failure is the composition — a resolution by a role with no clearance authority, trusted downstream.
